title: Probeable programming-with-AI contest
summary: Students or teams solve five beginner programming problems whose specifications deliberately omit key details. AI tools are allowed, but students must identify ambiguity, query an input-output oracle, and use hidden-test verifiers to produce robust solutions.

sources.title: Probeable Problems for Beginner-level Programming-with-AI Contests
sources.evidence_quote: they were allowed to use AI code-generation tools

assessment.summary: Implement functions from incomplete specifications during a 90-minute contest.
student_actions: Probe an oracle with chosen inputs.
Submit code, use a verifier, and make a final submission.

student_role.description: ChatGPT, Codeium, and GitHub Copilot were explicitly permitted; omitted details prevented direct AI-only solutions.

grading.method: Submissions were evaluated by targeted and unrestricted hidden tests for omitted requirements.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: Twenty-six consenting teams comprising 67 students participated.

evidence_excerpts.quote: they were allowed to use AI code-generation tools
